examples.liveReason: Original asks a model to select read/edit/shell tools and verifies actual file effects and hook timings.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts the app's read_file tool ran; the recording has no tool call
limitations: Initial native failures exposed /var versus /private/var containment mismatch. Canonicalizing the workspace fixed it; unchanged original effect assertions passed, and a real-source alias/escape mutation regression protects the guard.
File tools reject paths outside the temporary workspace; shell calls have a ten-second timeout. Failed commands surface as tool failures.

nativeEvidence.failedAssertion: the snapshot holds the user message

limitations: Repeated native runs reached the original 1.5-second snapshot before user.message existed, even though real user history and deltas arrived afterward. Await a bounded C# reference-readiness correction; do not manufacture history or change the assertions.
A faster completed model can also fail the original post-join delta assertion.

examples.liveReason: Original requires a parent model tool call to create an owned child session, await its answer, and return it to the parent.
examples.exclusionReason: asserts a subagent tool created a child conversation; the recording has no tool call

nativeEvidence.failedAssertion: the subagent tool created exactly one child conversation

limitations: A native run with diagnostic-only instrumentation preserving all assertions passed the actual parent-tool/owned-child flow. Uninstrumented runs also failed with zero children; passing evidence does not erase model/tool-choice flakiness.
The child requests the original mai-code-1.1-flash choice; its effective model was not reported by this example and is not inferred from the request.
The original creates a new child on every tool invocation; no crash-reuse or task-owned cancellation guarantee is claimed.
